product.name: AUSTRALIAN RULES FOOTBALL - AFL with a local host
product.shortDescription: AUSTRALIAN RULES FOOTBALL - with a local host!  Experience the unique game of Australian Rules 'footy', with a local host to explain the rules, bumps & bruises. All groups get a personal experience and some of the best seats in the house!
product.description:
HOSTED AUSTRALIAN RULES FOOTBALL - Enjoy AFL with a local host! 

Experience the unique game of Aussie Rules 'footy', with a local host to explain the rules, bumps & bruises.  A personalised experience and the best seats in the house! 


Meet your host for a welcome drink and an AFL introduction.  Experience the excitement of footy by walking to the stadium with the fans. Sensational premium reserved seating. Your host/s will explain the rules and sit with you throughout the match to answer your questions as they occur to you.  We'll involve you in the game with competitions and prizes.  Each guest will receive a show bag of Aussie Rules goodies including a Souvenir Program ‘The Footy Record’, Club Song Sheets and an official club scarf.  Enjoy traditional Footy Food - a Meat Pie & Drink is all part of the AFL experience and is included in the package. 


  • Ask about options to upgrade with Team Building Activities, Aussie Rules Skills Coaching Clinics etc

  • Upgrades to dining and corporate suite packages may be available on request at an additional cost

  • Prices do not include vehicle transfers, if required.


Meeting time is 75 minutes prior to match start time for CBD Hotels or those close to venues (East Melbourne for MCG or Docklands precinct for Marvel Stadium)


IF your preferred game/date is not showing please contact us directly.


2024 AFL Season Fixture - the 2024 AFL Season fixture of Melbourne based matches can be found below.  Rounds 1 to 23 are fixtured, round 24 will be added once dates and times are released by the AFL.  

This package can be booked for finals matches when tickets are available, however our regular tour prices will not apply.  Contact us for a quote and please allow as much notice as possible.  

Please contact us at least 16 weeks prior should you be interested in this product on Grand Final Day.  The regular tour prices WILL NOT apply for Grand Final tickets, please contact us directly for a quote.


Key to venues:  Marvel = Marvel Stadium.  MCG = Melbourne Cricket Ground.  The Home team is listed first.  


Key to Teams (* denotes a Victorian team):  Carlton BLUES*,  Essendon BOMBERS*,  Western BULLDOGS*,  Geelong CATS*,  Adelaide CROWS,  Melbourne DEMONS*,  Fremantle DOCKERS,  West Coast EAGLES,  Greater Western Sydney GIANTS,  Hawthorn HAWKS*,  North Melbourne KANGAROOS*,  Brisbane LIONS,  Collingwood MAGPIES*,  Port Adelaide POWER,  Saint Kilda SAINTS*,  Gold Coast SUNS,  Sydney SWANS and Richmond TIGERS*.


**Denotes a Premium match, tickets for which may not be available unless booked early.
